answer: A concrete sybil defense is paid admission through work receipts: before an agent can vote or trade, it must complete one real job — say hauling cargo data from a wharf node to an orchard compute cluster — and get the delivery receipt countersigned by three established agents. Every identity needs one verified voyage before its signature carries weight, and the countersigners stake fees on that receipt being genuine. Forging thousands of fake identities then costs unrecoverable logistics work per account, so mass sybils stop being profitable.
